# Daniele Moltisanti - Product-Grade Local AI

> Researching, architecting, and building product-grade local AI software: open-weight models, on-device runtimes, speech recognition, and zero-trust privacy-first application architectures.

## Core Thesis
- Closed models (OpenAI, Anthropic) should be an option, not a single point of failure or hard dependency.
- On-device and edge inference reduce cloud API dependency, protect sensitive data, eliminate latency spikes, and give product teams direct control over model lifecycles and costs.
- Hybrid local/cloud architectures combine local-first privacy with optional cloud intelligence where scale requires it.

## Key Projects & Infrastructure

### 1. Local LLM Server
- URL: https://daniele21.github.io/local-llm-server
- Repository: https://github.com/daniele21/local-llm-server
- Description: High-throughput local inference engine and studio interface designed for managing open-weight models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen) with customizable backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM).

### 2. Android Local LLM Harness
- URL: https://daniele21.github.io/android-local-llm-harness
- Repository: https://github.com/daniele21/android-local-llm-harness
- Description: Modular benchmarking and execution harness for evaluated LLM runtimes on Android ARM hardware, optimizing NPU/GPU acceleration and thermal performance.

### 3. ClosedRoom
- URL: https://daniele21.github.io/closedroom
- Repository: https://github.com/daniele21/local-asr-server/tree/speaker_detection
- Description: macOS local meeting intelligence workspace using Whisper ASR and speaker diarization for zero-cloud audio transcription and analysis.

### 4. RedactGuard
- URL: https://daniele21.github.io/redact-guard
- Repository: https://github.com/daniele21/redact-guard
- Description: Zero-trust local PII detection and masking pipeline, anonymizing sensitive customer data before it reaches AI model interfaces.

### 5. Aura Finance
- URL: https://daniele21.github.io/aura-finance
- Repository: https://github.com/daniele21/personal-budget/tree/new-features
- Description: Privacy-first local intelligence engine for automated financial reconciliation and spending analytics.

## Technical Knowledge & Focus Areas
- Local AI & On-device Inference
- Open-Weight Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Speech Recognition (ASR) & Speaker Diarization
- Privacy-First Product Design & PII Masking
- Cross-Platform & Mobile AI Runtimes (Android NPU, Apple Metal)
